description: This file is a CMake script used for configuring build and code generation tasks related to a JSON generator. It defines functions for invoking an external Python-based JSON generator and associated documentation generation, handling various configuration options and validations.

methods.name: JsonGenerator
methods.description: A function that constructs and executes a command to run an external Python script for JSON code generation, based on provided arguments and options.

methods.name: DocGenerator
methods.description: A function that sets up and invokes the JSON generator with documentation-specific parameters, and installs generated documentation files.
